summary: Keep UNKNOWN page contexts neutral while aggregating RFI roles so they cannot manufacture a missing Question or Response.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy across RFI, Submittal and email content
Existing requirement that exact workflow relationships avoid guessed matches
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued RFI accuracy improvements.
